sources.role: live-board path (official Digitransit Routing API v2 HSL — not wired)
sources.title: Routing API — Helsinki region
sources.note: Official next-train / departure-board path for HSL including metro. Production APIs require a free digitransit-subscription-key as header or query param (portal-api.digitransit.fi). POST, Content-Type application/graphql or application/json. Query stop { stoptimesWithoutPatterns { scheduledDeparture realtimeDeparture departureDelay realtime headsign trip { route { shortName } } } } and filter subway / metro / route shortName M1|M2. Rautatientori and Helsinki Central are different stop-places — doNotGroup. Static HSL GTFS is NOT a D1 generator. D1 stays planned.

sources.role: live-board path (official HSL GTFS-RT v2 — not wired)
sources.title: GTFS-RT feeds | HSL developer documentation
sources.note: Official HSL GTFS-RT 2.0. Trip updates every 15s; vehicle positions 1s; service alerts 5 min. No query filter — whole HSL feed. Trip IDs are not stable; identify by route_id + start_date + start_time + direction_id. Digitransit api.digitransit.fi GTFS-RT hosts are deprecated; use these realtime.hsl.fi URLs. D1 stays planned.

sources.note: Open HFP v2. Topic /hfp/v2/journey/# ; filter mode metro. Prefer TLS 8883. Vehicle positions also in GTFS-RT at realtime.hsl.fi. Not a D1 generator. D1 stays planned.

notes: D1 oracle is official HSL passenger metro maps and line diagrams HAND-TRANSCRIBED: Metro haarukka 10/2023 plus Tervetuloa metroon 2/2025 Reitti column, confirmed by 02/2026 metro station sheets (Rautatientori, Kamppi, Helsingin yliopisto, Itäkeskus). Stations arrays are not generated from GTFS. Not generated from Digitransit Routing / GTFS-RT / HFP. Not generated from Wikipedia. Not generated from helsinginmetro.fi.

City id helsinki is unused in existing packs (berlin, munich, hamburg, oslo, rotterdam, goteborg, malmo, uppsala, washington, …). Display Helsinki. Agency HKL / HSL (HSL authority; HKL / Kaupunkiliikenne operator — Tervetuloa 2/2025 prints HSL + Kaupunkiliikenne). Not VR, not HSL bus / tram / ferry, not commuter-rail letters. Do not invent city=finland or merge into a rail city.
City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: TRAIN-like = metro M1 and M2 only. No tram, no bus, no HSL/VR commuter rail, no Suomenlinna ferry, no unopened extensions.
Timezone Europe/Helsinki HAS DST (EEST/EET). Do not copy no-DST cities.

Two printed metro lines on the official HSL trunk page and 2/2025 sheet: M1 Kivenlahti–Vuosaari; M2 Tapiola–Mellunmäki. Current west branches: Kivenlahti (M1) and Tapiola (M2). Matinkylä is a published stop, not a current west terminus (it was the west end 2017–2 Dec 2022). Current east branches: Vuosaari (M1) and Mellunmäki (M2).

Locked inner-city printed name: Rautatientori (both lines; official English subtitle Central Railway Station on the metro sheet). Not Helsinki, not City, not Helsingin keskusta (map blob), not Kamppi (west neighbour + bus terminal), not Helsingin yliopisto (east neighbour), not Päärautatieasema / Helsinki Central railway (juna-asemat sheet — doNotGroup). doNotGroup metro vs VR/commuter at Helsinki Central and at Pasila (Pasila has no metro).
30 unique passenger-open metro stop strings. 46 line ticks (M1 27 + M2 19). Matches the published 30-asema network after Länsimetro to Kivenlahti.

Map vs halt list: lock official Finnish strings from the haarukka / tervetuloa Reitti column. Aalto-yliopisto not Aalto University. Helsingin yliopisto not University of Helsinki / Kaisaniemi. Rautatientori is the metro string — never Helsinki or Central Railway Station as the metro stop. Keep ä/ö: Matinkylä, Mellunmäki, Itäkeskus, Sörnäinen, Niittykumpu, Kägeludden is Swedish only.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are passenger codes M1 and M2 printed on the HSL trunk page and haarukka (HSL feed internals are not print locks). No stopIds in this file.

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): Official Digitransit Routing v2 POST https://api.digitransit.fi/routing/v2/hsl/gtfs/v1 stop.stoptimesWithoutPatterns (header digitransit-subscription-key) and HSL GTFS-RT GET https://realtime.hsl.fi/realtime/trip-updates/v2/hsl.
